links.outcome: Readability (FRES, FKGL) of LLM patient education responses on keratoconus
links.effect: All models produced difficult-to-read content (FRES: Gemini 49.7, Copilot 45.4, ChatGPT 40.7), with FKGL values at late high school level.
links.quote: All models produced difficult-to-read content (FRES: Gemini 49.7, Copilot 45.4, ChatGPT 40.7), with FKGL values at late high school level.

screen.reason: The study evaluates the accuracy, completeness, quality, and readability of three commercial LLMs responding to keratoconus-related patient questions, but does not test an organizational deployment practice or safeguard.
